FLUIDS / MAGNESIUM

Magnesium

Daily dosing stays daily: a shorter preparation contains a proportional fraction of the daily amount.

These are the workbook’s two dose options, not an automatic serum-Mg treatment rule. Assess indication, renal function, dilution, and monitoring separately. Evidence and limits.

Preparation

Linked: pump rate = final volume ÷ duration. Edit rate or duration; the other updates. This is the complete diluted infusion, not the MgSO₄ stock rate.

Stock concentrations — locked by default
Locked

Workbook default: 4 mEq/mL. Some 50% labels specify 4.06 mEq/mL; verify the vial and edit deliberately if needed. Stock volume must be diluted, not administered undiluted.

Dose conventions & preparation timing

Higher-dose option: 1 mEq/kg/day for low Mg. Lower-dose option: 0.5 mEq/kg/day for within-range Mg with refractory K, as in the workbook. Dose units are mEq/kg/day. The table shows the amount for the entered hours, not a whole daily dose compressed into that time.

The result helps locate a workbook option; it does not automatically prescribe or select a dose.
